root_cause: tests/requirements_pytorch pins numpy==1.26.4 for python_version < 3.12, but the installed pyarrow wheel (pulled transitively via the datasets package used by test_hf_transformers.py's load_model) requires NumPy >= 2.0 at import time. pip's resolver installs both packages without a hard version conflict, leaving an ABI-incompatible pyarrow/numpy pair in the Windows NPU test environment. Every precommit test that imports `datasets` (and transitively pyarrow) fails immediately, independent of the PR under test; PR #39512 only modifies a benchmarks CSV file and is unrelated to this failure.
reproduction_steps: On a Windows (or any) runner: pip install -r tests/requirements_pytorch (locks numpy==1.26.4), then pip install the model_hub_tests pytorch requirements that pull in `datasets`/pyarrow, then run: python -m pytest install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_hf_transformers.py -k test_convert_model_precommit. The ImportError reproduces on the first `from datasets import Audio, load_dataset` call inside load_model.
recommended_actions: Pin pyarrow explicitly in the pytorch model-hub test requirements to a version built against NumPy 1.x (e.g. pyarrow<17), or bump tests/requirements_pytorch's numpy pin to >=2.0 for python_version < 3.12 if downstream model-hub tests tolerate it.
Add an explicit `datasets`/`pyarrow` version constraint near the numpy==1.26.4 pin in tests/requirements_pytorch so pip's resolver cannot select an incompatible pyarrow build.
Re-run the NPU/PyTorch Models tests jobs after the pin is corrected to confirm all previously failing test_hf_transformers.py cases pass across all NPU platform shards (3720, 4000, 5010, 5020, 6010).
prevention_strategies: When pinning numpy for compatibility reasons, also audit and pin transitive packages (pyarrow, datasets) that have hard NumPy ABI version floors, and add a CI smoke check that imports `datasets`/pyarrow right after requirements installation to fail fast with a clear message instead of deep inside a multiprocessing worker on every NPU platform shard.
historical_context: This exact signature has now recurred 7 times since 2026-11-05 (first seen 2026-11-05T01:47:23Z, most recently on run 42647164675 just prior to this one at 2026-11-09T17:09:09Z, now again on run 42647164508 across all 5 NPU platform shards), always on unrelated merge-queue PRs, confirming the break stems from the requirements_pytorch/pyarrow pin mismatch rather than any PR content.
